en: Oh no! My friend is sick in bed today... What can I do?
Listen! <SAW> taught us: visiting a sick friend is like picking fruit in the gardens of Paradise, until you come back!
So let's go! We make a get-well card, and take some fruit.
Knock, knock! Assalamu alaikum! We came to see you!
We sit with him, smile, and make a prayer: may Allah make you better!
Look, he is smiling! Our visit made him feel better already!
Who can you visit or call this week? Tell your grown-up!
